what: Picture props (animals, stickers) scattered on one plate each shake for .6s, one at a time every 1.8s. Eight steps jump four times to random spots within ±4px·±4° and then return, stepped with steps(6), so they jolt like hand-drawn stop motion. Only one shakes at a time, so the whole plate stays quietly alive.

options.every: Interval before moving to the next prop (s), default 1.8
options.hops: Number of bounces before returning to place, default 4
options.start: enter (starts when visible, default) · event (starts when the element receives fx:start — for shaking after an earlier entrance effect has finished)

from.where: index.html .nav-pic-case (five animals of the island picture, fx:start after they drop down)
from.options: every: 1.8; dur: .6; steps: 6; range: 4; start: event

note: The original puts nine transform keyframes into steps(6, end) using Web Animations (element.animate) — the same approach, so it runs without GSAP. The first jitter comes one interval after the start (the original also commented out the first call)
